method: Assessment A isolated design review; fresh Playwright Edge context

heuristics.name: Visibility of System Status
heuristics.keyIssue: Copy and empty states are clear; the filtered result count is per group.

heuristics.name: Match Between System and Real World
heuristics.keyIssue: Chinese labels are natural, while P0/P1/P2 and kebab-case remain maintainer language.

heuristics.name: User Control and Freedom
heuristics.keyIssue: Search can be cleared and groups can be collapsed.

heuristics.name: Consistency and Standards
heuristics.keyIssue: Native buttons and details/summary patterns behave predictably.

heuristics.name: Error Prevention
heuristics.keyIssue: Input examples and empty-state recovery are clear.

heuristics.name: Recognition Rather Than Recall
heuristics.keyIssue: Icon labels and synonyms help; every group starts collapsed.

heuristics.name: Flexibility and Efficiency of Use
heuristics.keyIssue: Basic keyboard flow works; shortcuts, favorites, and batch copy are absent.

heuristics.name: Aesthetic and Minimalist Design
heuristics.keyIssue: Clear hierarchy; seven peer categories and long reference content compete for attention.

heuristics.name: Help Users Recognize, Diagnose, and Recover from Errors
heuristics.keyIssue: Copy failure explains manual recovery and preserves the selected code.

heuristics.name: Help and Documentation
heuristics.keyIssue: Usage and specification guidance is complete but embedded in a long page.

failedChecklistItems: Chunking: seven peer categories are shown together; expanded groups contain 10 to 29 icons.
Minimal choices: the initial browsing decision presents seven category choices, above the four-item reference threshold.

priorityIssues.title: All seven catalog groups start collapsed
Mobile copy toast overlays the navigation header
Narrow-screen checklist table is difficult to read

boundary: Assessment B and code review reports were not read.
Edge/Chromium was used; Safari, Firefox, and real screen readers were not tested.
Clipboard failure was simulated by rejecting navigator.clipboard.writeText in the isolated page.
